incidents.name: Sperax USDs balance recalculation bug
incidents.notes: A rebasing-balance recalculation in the USDs token let an account's credited balance be inflated by toggling its rebase opt-in state, minting USDs out of nothing.

sources.ref: onchain review: USDs proxy 0xD74f5255D557944cf7Dd0E45FF521520002D5748 created 2021-12-23T02:42:11Z by 0x42d2f9f84eeb86574aa4e9fcccfd74066d809600, not the attack-tx sender 0x26c1fd9fd5a1338aabbdbe3f64f3e73369a0f4a0; five EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last at block 48326486 on 2022-12-23T16:54:05Z installing 0x97a7e6cf949114fe4711018485d757b9c4962307 (the address the PoC labels USDsImpl), so the executing code was 42.3 days old. Loss ~309k USDs per the DeFiHackLabs 2023 index entry for this PoC; USDs is USD-pegged and taken at 1:1.
